Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", new ConversionOptions { HiddenContent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<HiddenContent>("\"Reachable\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
